what: Ambient global declared in a sibling .d.ts. Everything reachable through it is external ABI, so the stub records what it is handed — a name only reached through a host global is only observable if the stub uses it.

globalStubs.MyGlobal: { foo: "FOO", bar: 7, f: (input) => { console.log("MyGlobal.f", input); return { y: input.x * 2 }; } }
